fast_eval_note: fast_eval is false. EVAL_SMOKE only caps tune, validation, and test query counts. Selection, guardrails, exact metrics, and cluster bootstrap use the same path as a full eval.

extrapolated_full_run.note: Pool builds scale with uncapped query counts times the number of distinct cached pool configurations in this run. Tuning overhead, exact metrics, bootstrap, and variant share audits scale by the matching split. Latency stays at the 500-query benchmark.

image_weight_note: Image coverage is at least 5%; the image block is eligible.
transform_selection_reason: default tail_log tied or led validation mean NDCG
selection_reason: only binary variant available or binary won outright

variant_guardrails_binary_vs_A.weights: each variant's tuned weights; selection rule unchanged

rating_coverage.scoring: The rating block is active only when rating_n > 0 and the rating is finite for both the query and the candidate. rating_n == 0 is missing and the block is imputed to the calibrated 0.5. That rule was not changed.
rating_coverage.why_pair_active_is_0_73: pair_active_rates.rating draws 5000 ordered pairs with replacement (the same row can be drawn twice). Its expectation is the square of the row share (0.8530^2 = 0.7277). The distinct-pair share is 0.7277. The sampled value 0.7300 matches that expectation, so the block is not active more often than the plan.

rating_missing_when_n_zero: rating block active only when rating_n>0 for query and candidate; otherwise imputed to 0.5 calibrated
